content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-93. - Applicability.
content.summary:
This article shall apply to every item of property in the custody of the custodian
               on the effective date of this ordinance and to all items of property coming into the
               custody of the custodian thereafter.
(
Ord. No. 4238, § 1, 12-6-2010
)
